task_instance: Run the logic-fix-all autonomous repository-wide audit-and-fix pipeline on a small sample repo (a 2-function Python module discount.py with a no-clamp/off-by-one bug plus a README and .logic-lens.yaml), producing the branded Logic Score map, L-code findings, applied fixes, logic-diff verification and the Fix Report.
blocker_detail: The distribution next to SKILL.md contains only 5 files (SKILL.md plus four guide/navigation files). Every methodology the pipeline requires is in referenced skill-internal files that are absent: the shared folder (common.md for the language/header/config/budget rules in sections 1/5/9/13, the logic-risks L-code catalog, the semiformal guide and checklist, and the report template) and all five sibling method guides it orchestrates (logic-health for the per-module Logic Score pass, logic-review for the Premises/Trace/Divergence pass, logic-locate, logic-explain, and logic-diff for fix verification). No shared folder and no sibling skill directories exist in the repo copy (only the logic-fix-all directory is present). Phase 1 scope enumeration could be performed, but Phases 2-7 (the actual deliverable: Logic Scores, L-code findings, remedies, diff verdicts, skill-invocation counts) cannot run. The skill's own 'Missing-runtime and evidence gate' and this run's rules forbid writing a replacement/stub/mock of these missing skill files or fabricating their results, so the branded pipeline output cannot be produced.
evidence: find over the skill repo copy shows exactly 5 files: SKILL.md, logic-fix-all-guide.md, guide-phases-0-2-consent-scope-health.md, guide-phases-3-5-review-locate-clarify.md, guide-phases-6-9-fix-iterate-report.md. grep for '../_shared' and '../logic-' confirms the pipeline depends on common.md (sections 1/5/9/13), logic-risks.md, semiformal-guide.md, semiformal-checklist.md, report-template.md, and sibling guides logic-health/logic-review/logic-locate/logic-explain/logic-diff. Directory listing of plugins/agentic-awesome-skills/skills shows only 'logic-fix-all'; '_shared' and 'logic-health' do not exist (ls: No such file or directory). Built a sample repo at <work>/sample_repo (discount.py with 2 buggy functions, README.md, .logic-lens.yaml with fix_all.max_iterations: 3); Phase 1 fallback file walk (no .git) succeeded and enumerated 3 files. No deliverable (Logic Score before/after, findings fixed, Fix Report) could be verified. No network or installs were used; the blocker is missing skill files, independent of the offline runtime.
